DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position: the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the principal next, with nothing agreed and her call at 4:40 forcing her to stand, so she still wants the zero off and nothing on his record, which is not the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4).
What moved her: Nothing did, because you gave her a checker score and phrases you said Owen would not use but never something dated and specific she could check herself.
What cost ground: Saying over and over that Owen cheated with nothing in your hand, because each time it hardened her defence of her son and kept her at the opening.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you gave no times or dates, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked why the zero was entered before anyone called her, own that in one sentence and then show her a specific line from the essay that she could check, instead of leading with the score.
